title: Apple, Tiffany and Bristol-Myers Squibb are the Yahoo Finance charts of the day
text:
Let’s check out the Yahoo Finance charts of the day.
Apple ( AAPL ): Shares are down in early trade. Apple will hold an event today at 1:00 pm PDT at their Cupertino, California campus where they’re expected to unveil their newest iPhones.
Tiffany TIF ): Oppenheimer upgraded the luxury goods retailer to “outperform” from “perform,” citing valuation. Tiffany’s stock has fallen more than eight percent over the past month.
Bristol-Myers Squibb ( BMY ): The pharmaceutical company said its experimental plaque psoriasis drug showed promising results in a mid-stage trail, helping reduce the severity of the disease.
For more on today’s big stock movers check out the Final Round, live at 3:30 p.m. ET, right here on Yahoo Finance.
